recognize_zh: 視野中四顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質豐富、淺藍色帶細纖維紋理，小核偏心，外觀似 Gaucher 細胞；背景滿是各階段幼紅血球（紅血球系增生），配合乙型地中海貧血病史，應判為假性 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm showing fine fibrillary/striated texture
Small, round, eccentric to central nuclei with coarse chromatin
A few cells with small ingested dark nuclear debris (likely phagocytosed erythroid nuclei)
Marked erythroid hyperplasia with abundant basophilic, polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with marked erythroid hyperplasia, including numerous normoblasts at all stages of maturation. Scattered among them are large macrophages with small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm bearing a fine fibrillary, Gaucher-like texture, some containing ingested nuclear debris. Background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis. In a patient with beta thalassemia, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells reflecting increased cell turnover in the setting of ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: True Gaucher cells are morphologically near-identical on light microscopy, but show reduced glucocerebrosidase activity, GBA1 mutations and tubular inclusions on electron microscopy.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than diffuse fibrillary blue cytoplasm; they may also occur in thalassemia.
MAC-laden histiocytes show negative-image striations and are acid-fast positive, typically in immunocompromised patients.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells of CML or myeloma
ddx.vs: These are morphologically identical, so the association is made from the background marrow: myeloid hyperplasia with basophilia in CML or clonal plasma cells in myeloma rather than erythroid hyperplasia.
